name: e3-audit
js: (async()=>{ const m=IRV.app.model; const keys=new Set(['crediting_rate','net_yield','mva_rate','base_rate','periodic_payment_rate','periodic_accumulation_rate','not_offered','published','via_wayback']); for(const s of m.series){ if(/[_]|\d-\d/.test(s.plan)||/^[a-z]+$/.test(s.plan)) keys.add(s.plan); } for(const p of m.products){ keys.add(p.id); } for(const t of m.types) if(/_/.test(t.key)) keys.add(t.key); const found={}; const scan=(where)=>{ const text=[document.getElementById('page').innerText, ...[...document.querySelectorAll('#page [title]')].map(e=>e.title), ...[...document.querySelectorAll('#page option')].map(o=>o.textContent)].join('\n'); for(const k of keys){ const re=new RegExp('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])'+k.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')+'($|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])'); if(re.test(text)) (found[where]=found[where]||[]).push(k); } if(/\.csv|\.json/.test(text)) (found[where]=found[where]||[]).push('file name'); }; const W=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); for(const v of ['home','explore','markets','moves','chart','data']){ IRV.app.go(v); await W(700); scan(v); } for(const p of m.products){ for(const tab of ['rates','history','docs']){ IRV.app.go('product',{id:p.id}); const b=document.querySelector('[data-tab='+tab+']'); if(b) b.click(); await W(tab==='docs'?900:350); scan('product '+IRV.nameEn(p)+' / '+tab); } } return found; })()
